Title: Automatic tracking of click events with Application Insights is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor Application Insights is a cloud native application monitoring offering which enables customers to observe failures, bottlenecks, and usage patterns to improve application performance and effectiveness. The new JavaScript Click Analytics Auto-Collection Plugin now enables you to collect click events that can be used analyze usage patterns and conduct retention analysis.
